pull_request.title: Search and ship stock, and pad shelf labels

review.summary: Search builds its query from the prefix, Ship can lose a concurrent update, and its shortage error reports the wrong number.

findings.title: Search concatenates the prefix into its SQL
findings.body: The prefix is pasted into the LIKE pattern, so a prefix holding a quote rewrites the query. Pass it as a parameter.
findings.evidence: store.go:45 builds "... LIKE '" + prefix + "%' ..." and runs it with Query.

findings.title: Shortage error reports the requested quantity as the stock
findings.body: The error says only <quantity> are in stock, but quantity is what was asked for; available is what is in stock.
findings.evidence: store.go:71 formats "only %d in stock" with quantity.

findings.title: Ship overwrites the stock with a value read earlier
findings.body: Ship reads the quantity, then sets it to that value minus the shipment, so a Receive or Ship between the two is lost. Decrement in the UPDATE itself, guarded by the quantity.
findings.evidence: store.go:66 reads available; store.go:73 sets quantity = available - quantity.
